causal_hypothesis: V8 failed before science because one Bash local declaration expanded an unset variable, scp consumed the checkpoint-manifest loop stdin after its first row, and the activated hook module was staged under a basename that did not match its import. Splitting the declaration, isolating scp stdin from manifest iteration, and staging the import-correct module name should make cold staging resumable and reach candidate-server activation without changing the intervention.

Stage inputs/activated_multiresolution_global_kv.py at the guest basename multiresolution_global_kv.py required by streaming_global_kv_sglang_hook.py.
Require a durable guest checkpoint integrity marker binding all eight manifest rows before image or server launch; reuse matching immutable files and transfer only missing or mismatched destinations.

Preserve atomic claim-generation capture, generation-fenced release, bounded children, independent staging/server deadlines, live server supervision, fresh repair IDs, and executable retained-claim repair control flow.
Treat every pre-science integration failure as retained repair under a live owner; separate decision-bearing success/negative release from incomplete or recoverable retention.
